title: CLTR Cutover ReadinessPackage record
description: Phase 136L, Implementation Group 3. Shape-only wire contract for a ReadinessEvidencePackage companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.20). A ReadinessPackage document reports evidence toward a proposed cutover; it never itself establishes readiness truth, cutover eligibility, human authorization, certification, CAS success, publication success, or current authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Per Sec.19.1 (repaired by Phase 136D): this record's identity is content-derived solely from its own bound fields and never depends on any cutover_request identity -- a readiness_package is created first, and a cutover_request is created second, binding to this already-existing package by record_reference; this record carries no back-reference to any cutover_request, closing the loop non-circularly. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14): additionalProperties permits exactly one reserved key, _extensions, string-valued map only. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes readiness_package).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the ReadinessPackage schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2. Content-derived solely from this record's own bound fields (Sec.19.1 repair notice) -- never from any cutover_request identity.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

phase_id.description: Always present. readiness_package is one of the families requiring phase_id (Sec.7.2).

transition_id.description: Always present. Sec.20's own field table unconditionally requires phase_id/transition_id/migration_epoch 'all three'; this is disclosed as a textual inconsistency against Sec.7.2's family-required-field table, which does not list readiness_package among the transition_id-required families -- resolved in favor of the more specific, per-family Sec.20 table (finding NON-BLOCKING-136L-2; see phase documentation, mirroring the 136K precedent of confirming rather than silently patching contract text).

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1).

evidence_references.description: Always present as a key; may be empty. Deterministically ordered by record_id, lexicographic ASCII byte order (Sec.20; matching this repository's existing canonicalization sort convention) -- ordering itself is a Layer 3/canonicalization-time responsibility, not something this JSON Schema document can enforce (JSON Schema validates item shape only, never semantic array order). No family restriction is applied: an evidence reference may point at any of the 16 companion record_family values, or at Stage 1/Stage 2 lifecycle evidence outside this companion package's own record_family vocabulary, addressed opaquely by the generic record_reference shape.

prerequisite_status.description: Always present. Record-local, package-wide summary of whether this package's own declared prerequisites are met (Sec.20). A schema-valid 'met' value never itself proves the underlying prerequisites were actually verified -- that is Layer 4.

findings.description: Always present as a key; may be empty. Array of lightweight local finding objects (id, verdict, title) -- explicitly not the full findings-table format used in phase documentation (Sec.20).

state.description: Always present. Record-local ReadinessState (Sec.8.8, 5 values). 'conflict' requires findings to contain at least one BLOCKING-verdict entry (Sec.20, enforced below); no other state-to-content conditional is locally enforced by this phase (no further Sec.16 row exists for readiness_package). A 'ready' value here never itself proves cutover eligibility, evidence freshness, or cross-record consistency (Layer 4).

gate_result.description: Conditionally present: not listed in Sec.20's own required-field table, but Sec.8.8 assigns GateResult's home schema as readiness_package.schema.json, restating CLTR-CUTOVER-001 Sec.10's frozen four-value gate outcome -- included here as an optional field so the enum has a documented home, without overclaiming a requiredness Sec.20's table does not state (finding NON-BLOCKING-136L-1, same category as the 'state' field gap on cutover_request; see phase documentation). A schema-valid value here never itself resolves cutover eligibility (Layer 4/6).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless.

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as readiness truth.

id.description: Always present. Opaque finding identifier, ASCII-only, no path separators.

verdict.description: Always present. Closed finding-classification vocabulary matching this repository's existing phase-report finding taxonomy. A finding's verdict never itself makes an authority or lifecycle decision -- it is a disclosure only.

title.description: Always present. Short, single-line printable-ASCII finding title.

finding.description: A lightweight local finding object (Sec.20) -- not the full findings-table format used in phase documentation.

blocking_finding.description: A finding locally restricted to verdict 'BLOCKING', used by the state == 'conflict' conditional above.
